actions: Lab window with 480x360..1400x1000 constraints; real border drags; change to 600x400..900x700; clear pairs with null; invalid updates; observed vs KWin max/fullscreen/focus/minimize; unsupported ops; attention with Konsole focused
C01.expected: Constraints enforced/cleared; invalid rejected without change; unknown is null; unsupported explicit; attention acknowledged
C01.observed: Drags clamp at min/max (height limited by screen edge once); cleared min allows 207x200 (KWin minimum); invalid pairs rejected, requested unchanged; observed focus/max/fullscreen track KWin, minimized/visible/position null; hidden/visibility/focus/position/unminimize -> -32001; attention sets demandsAttention, presented null; cancel -> -32001

actions: Stylesheet with prefers-color-scheme/contrast/reduced-motion; plasma-apply-colorscheme Light/Dark; app overrides and system; GNOME high-contrast key (portal gtk backend); KDE animation factor; portal restart; 30 s idle D-Bus
C02.expected: Native observation, override precedence, unknown stays null, no idle polling
C02.observed: BreezeLight is reported by the KDE portal as no-preference -> null and default light; override dark wins over OS changes and system returns; high_contrast observed true/false; KDE exposes no reduced-motion key (null, source default); reduced-motion override changes media (1s->0s); updates continue after portal restart; 0 D-Bus messages in 30 s idle; settings restored
limitations: prefers-contrast media feature is not implemented (documented: high contrast observed, no forced-colors palette)
KDE portal provides no reduced-motion value

actions: query_nodes on anonymous li; node_batch; batch with stale node rolls back; remove/replace and reuse old handle; real-pointer callbacks doing nested RPC and removing own target; document replacement and unload with old handles
C03.observed: Rollback atomic; old handles stale; nested RPC ok; one click delivered, recreated target untouched; old document id and node handles rejected after replacement (defect D3 fixed: node references now carry document identity)

actions: UTF-16 get/set selection both directions; split-surrogate rejection; replace + undo/redo; real keyboard grapheme navigation/deletion; readonly/password/beforeinput-cancelled fields; paste; IME in text/password/readonly/email/textarea
C04.observed: All as expected; cancellation prevents typing/paste/programmatic replace; IME purposes reach fcitx5 (password hidden+sensitive, email purpose, multiline hint, readonly disabled)
limitations: Blur during composition keeps the composed text in its own field and resets the platform preedit (browser behavior; CORE_1.0_SPEC keeps existing composition behavior). Nothing leaks into the next field. Read literally, C04's sentence could demand discarding instead; flagged for review.
Composition beforeinput events are not cancelable (documented engine contract, as in browsers)

actions: form_data with duplicates/disabled/external control/submitter; request_submit; Enter, pointer and Space submission; custom validity; reset + undo; real pickers single/multiple/cancel; labels; reset clears
C05.expected: Ordered entries, submitter identity, validity, reset, visible file labels
C05.observed: All as expected; labels 'Choose File — žluťoučký 日本.txt' and 'Choose Files — 2 files selected', empty after reset

actions: Real drags from Dolphin (file) and KWrite (text) into files/text/files text/none/disabled/inert/no-opt-in zones; GTK source: mixed URI+text, https URI, 1.1 MB text, 1025/1024 files, delayed transfer with removal/re-creation, policy change, document replacement, window close
C06.expected: Nearest eligible policy; rejections; limits; no retargeting
C06.observed: As expected; text-only receiver chooses text from a mixed offer; non-local URI/size limits explicit errors; delayed transfers discarded after target retirement or window close

actions: Real pointer boundary moves, right/middle/double click, prevented contextmenu, typing/selection/paste events, 8 s blocked Python worker
C07.observed: mouseover/out/enter/leave with related targets; auxclick/contextmenu/dblclick; contextmenu default_prevented true by rule; typing/scroll worked during block; queued events delivered after

actions: AT-SPI inspection of table/grid, tree, live region, relationships, ScrollIntoView (element and text run), stale objects; manifest app name; combobox via Orca, keyboard and Selection.select_child
C08.observed: App name 'UI4ME Core Lab'; cells with rowindex/colindex, rowcount/colcount; tree levels 1/2 with posinset/setsize; live/atomic/busy attributes; labelled-by/described-by/details relations; ScrollIntoView without selection change; old nodes defunct; combobox speaks value and emits active-descendant/selection events (defects D2, D7 fixed)
limitations: accesskit_unix 0.24.1 has no AT-SPI Table/TableCell interfaces: indices are object attributes; screen-reader table navigation commands needing those interfaces are unavailable
Relationships to elements that are not exposed accessibility nodes (plain generic spans) are dropped by design

actions: Register/replace displayed bundle (red->blue visible); traversal/absolute/257 entries/>1 MiB rejected with old bundle intact; 16 MiB aggregate; same-name replacement; 64 bundles; purge while displayed, remove, purge, unregister; decode failure; replacement churn
C09.observed: All contract items as expected (defect D5 fixed: replaced/removed images retained decoded rasters, +256 KiB per replacement)
limitations: OPEN FINDING: replacing a displayed bundle image still grows host PSS by ~17-19 KiB per replacement (240 replacements: +3.8 MB) with decoded cache flat at one raster; independent of AT-SPI and of the malloc mmap threshold; plain DOM churn and unused bundle registration are flat. Not yet attributed.

actions: Focused fixtures rendered by installed host and pinned Chromium: intrinsic flex basis, balanced wrap, break-word, content-sized select, resize grips (logical), inset elliptical shadows, @font-face feature defaults, sbix PNG glyph; widths 360/640/900
C10.expected: Declared behavior matches browser within explained rasterization differences
C10.observed: Marker geometry identical; sbix glyph pixel-identical; feature defaults and overrides match; select heights differ by UA padding
limitations: Resize grip is physical lower-right in RTL/vertical modes (ledger CSS-03 limit); Chromium mirrors it in RTL
